# AttestRWA

> AttestRWA is an open format, verifier and reference implementation for decision records: a canonical JSON record of why a compliance decision about a stablecoin settlement was made (policy version and hash, every input with its source, every rule with its result), whose keccak256 hash is anchored on-chain in an Ethereum Attestation Service (EAS) attestation with the schema `bytes32 dealId, address payee, address token, uint256 amount, uint8 decision, bytes32 policyHash, bytes32 recordHash` (UID 0x1a86145e70ac5055683604a56201574b2c9edf0512ad08fc1368a9e7cb565135). The `attestrwa verify` command recomputes the hash, compares the record with the attestation and with the escrow's state over JSON-RPC, checks the policy and registry files, and replays the rules. Install the verifier with `uvx --from "git+https://github.com/FUYOH666/attestrwa#subdirectory=packages/attestrwa" attestrwa verify record.json --rpc https://sepolia.base.org`. The repository also contains a Solidity escrow that releases or refunds on such a decision, a FastAPI attester (local base URL http://127.0.0.1:8080, OpenAPI at /docs, `POST /attest/settlement`, `GET /records/{deal_id}`, `POST /verify`) and a Next.js UI. Targets Base and Base Sepolia. Testnet reference implementation, not audited. Apache-2.0.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/FUYOH666/attestrwa/blob/main/README.md): what it does, quick start, features, what a record proves, FAQ
- [Decision Record v0.1](https://github.com/FUYOH666/attestrwa/blob/main/spec/DECISION_RECORD_v0.1.md): the format, canonical bytes, rule language, on-chain anchor, verification
- [JSON Schema](https://github.com/FUYOH666/attestrwa/blob/main/spec/decision-record-0.1.schema.json): schema of a record file
- [API](https://github.com/FUYOH666/attestrwa/blob/main/docs/API.md): attester endpoints, fields, errors, configuration
- [Architecture](https://github.com/FUYOH666/attestrwa/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): parts, flow, design decisions
- [Attestation schema](https://github.com/FUYOH666/attestrwa/blob/main/docs/ATTESTATION_SCHEMA.md): EAS schema and what the escrow checks
- [Policy packs](https://github.com/FUYOH666/attestrwa/blob/main/docs/POLICY_PACKS.md): input sources and the rule grammar
- [Threat model](https://github.com/FUYOH666/attestrwa/blob/main/docs/THREAT_MODEL.md): guarantees, closed defects, remaining risks
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/FUYOH666/attestrwa/blob/main/AGENTS.md): layout, commands, rules for coding agents
